gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-slabo-13px: Bold, puffy DynaPuff leaves each letter alone with room around it and a tall lowercase. Slabo 13px follows in a classic serif with big open counters, and a size bump for the body would help it.
gen-gf-dynapuff-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum reads dignified and editorial, with a high x-height and a wide-open c that feel almost woodblock. DynaPuff above it is all thick outline.
gen-gf-eagle-lake-fs-sentient: Sentient reads sophisticated and contemporary, with pinched apertures and crossbars a touch thinner than its stems. Its quality is the contrast: Eagle Lake's loose, hand-drawn gaps against that tight serif.
gen-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-arrows-fs-litera: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, its curves open wide. The pair's strength is a relaxed hand-drawn heading, Edu AU VIC WA NT Arrows, against a body with subtle thick and thin modulation.
gen-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-pre-fs-bespoke-s: Casual, personal letters lead in Edu AU VIC WA NT Pre. Bespoke Sans follows sharp and refined, with generous space where curves meet stems, so the low-slung handwriting gets a crisper, taller neighbor.
gen-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-pre-fs-literata: Literata is a text serif that feels bookish and sophisticated. Edu AU VIC WA NT Pre does best at casual, pen-like warmth with uniform strokes, while Literata handles the careful, moderately contrasted reading.
gen-gf-erica-one-gf-graduate: Expressive Erica One packs tight, closed shapes and a tall lowercase into every heading line. And Graduate, a dignified serif with generous spacing and strokes from one fixed nib, is the one built to open things up.
gen-gf-esteban-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code reads modern and neutral, a wire-like monoline with plenty of space between neighbors and smooth bends. And Esteban brings the bookish refinement above it, so a slightly larger body size may help.
gen-gf-esteban-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono reads modern and professional, its curves as thick as its stems and its letters standing like pins in a wide board. Esteban's understated stroke variation is the quality that lifts it.
gen-gf-esteban-gf-julius-sans-one: Esteban's tall middle zone makes its heading feel refined and bookish. Its slim crossbars suit headings, while Julius Sans One is best for open, uniform sans letters with wide gaps.
